place.title: Slayer Tower
place.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that he was now completely humiliated.

get_inside.text: The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.
Options to reach the asylum include:
Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor surface, then run south-west to the ancient door.

place.title: Senntisten Asylum
place.summary: Between the abyssal savages and abyssal lords is an asylum gate. The gate requires a gate key to unlock that can be obtained as a drop from abyssal lords. Once the gate is unlocked, players can bring a rope to hang from the broken railing to unlock a permanent shortcut to the lords. It is not required to open the door to access the lords as players can simply run around the asylum to reach the area, although it is longer, and players must run through aggressive abyssal beasts.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
Three Wilderness obelisks provide a fairly fast way to reach the maze:
The obelisk in level 44 Wilderness is the closest, from there run a short distance to the southeast.
The obelisk in level 35 Wilderness is a bit further, the maze entrance is towards the northwest.
The obelisk in level 27 Wilderness is the furthest but still practical, run a little distance to the north.
Players can also teleport to the Lava Maze by way of a lava titan's special ability.
Players can also ride a canoe to the Wilderness canoe landing, arriving near the level 35 Wilderness Obelisk.
A Wilderness sword 1 or higher can teleport players to the Wilderness herb patch, then walk west to the Lava Maze.
From the Wilderness Crater lodestone, players should run west then north, around the edge of the Wilderness Crater and up to the Lava Maze.

place.title: Lava Maze
place.summary: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45. In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are webs that must be cut with a slash weapon or a knife. It was previously possible for players to be trapped inside the maze if they did not have a slash weapon to cut webs, but having the tool belt with a knife will always allow you to cut through webs, even without a slash weapon or knife in your inventory.

place.title: Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon contains 5 caverns, the central one is inaccessible. The two northern caverns each contain a group of 7 dark beasts (14 dark beasts in total). The two southern caverns each contain a group of 8 abyssal demons (16 abyssal demons in total). 13 imps spawn and teleport all around the dungeon.

• Various Slayer masks

get_inside.text: Ancient Cavern
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.
Kuradal's Dungeon

place.title: Kuradal's Dungeon
place.summary: Once in the dungeon, players can only attack the Slayer monster they were assigned, and only while the task has not been completed. All monsters in the dungeon except dark beasts, greater demons, hellhounds, and gargoyles are non-aggressive. The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

place.title: Abyssal Area
place.summary: The abyssal area contains abyssal leeches, abyssal guardians, abyssal walkers, and abyssal demons. Here, only the abyssal demons are not aggressive. The other abyssal monsters follow the normal rules of aggressiveness and will attack all players regardless of their combat level. Walkers, guardians, and leeches spawn extremely fast, while abyssal demons take longer to respawn.

place.title: Slayer Tower
place.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that he was now completely humiliated.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
The entrance area of The Heart
pic: The entrance area of The Heart

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

place.title: Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon contains 5 caverns, the central one is inaccessible. The two northern caverns each contain a group of 7 dark beasts (14 dark beasts in total). The two southern caverns each contain a group of 8 abyssal demons (16 abyssal demons in total). 13 imps spawn and teleport all around the dungeon.

get_inside.text: Ancient Cavern
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.
Kuradal's Dungeon

place.title: Kuradal's Dungeon
place.summary: Once in the dungeon, players can only attack the Slayer monster they were assigned, and only while the task has not been completed. All monsters in the dungeon except dark beasts, greater demons, hellhounds, and gargoyles are non-aggressive. The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

place.title: Abyssal Area
place.summary: The abyssal area contains abyssal leeches, abyssal guardians, abyssal walkers, and abyssal demons. Here, only the abyssal demons are not aggressive. The other abyssal monsters follow the normal rules of aggressiveness and will attack all players regardless of their combat level. Walkers, guardians, and leeches spawn extremely fast, while abyssal demons take longer to respawn.

place.title: Slayer Tower
place.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that he was now completely humiliated.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

get_inside.text: To enter the Abyss, the player needs to complete the Enter the Abyss miniquest. Once players have completed the miniquest, they can use the 'Teleport' option on the Mage of Zamorak north of Edgeville in level 4 to 6 Wilderness to enter the Abyss.
Strategy

For convenience, players can make the Mage of Zamorak teleport them straight away with a left-click by going through his 'Configure' option; this only has to be done once. Completing the Wilderness achievements increases the rate of gathering magical thread by 5% (easy), 10% (medium), 15% (hard), or 33% (elite).
Other notes

Inside the Abyss, the player is no longer in the Wilderness and cannot be attacked by other players. However, if a player attacks immediately before a player enters the Abyss, the attack can hit after the player has been teleported inside due to lag. If the player is teleblocked by another player before entering, using the 'Teleport' option on the Zamorak Mage will not work.

Altars are located throughout the world, often near points of interest. If no other teleports are available, the abyss is useful as an alternate method of teleportation. Some useful locations include:
Air altar - Cooks' Guild, west of Varrock
Astral altar - Lunar Isle, switching spellbooks on the altar
Blood altar - Master clue skill riddle, mutated bloodvelds for slayer,
Body altar - Barbarian Village
Cosmic altar - Elite clue Zanaris scan spots, mutated zygomites for slayer
Death altar - Master clue skill riddle, end of the Temple of Light from the quest Mourning's End Part II, re-entering the Underground Pass to get Iban's staff
Earth altar - East of Varrock elite clue spots
Fire altar - Mage Training Arena, Het's Oasis, Al Kharid
Law altar - Entrana
Mind altar - Goblin Village, Black Knight's Fortress elite clue spot
Nature altar - Gleaming wisps, Karamja, Shilo Village, hard and elite clue spots
Soul altar - Far west of Menaphos Imperial district for City Quests and elite clue scan spots, fairy ring
Time altar - Access to venomous, feral, and brutish dinosaurs for slayer
Water altar - Lumbridge Swamp, Zanaris

To use a teleport, enter the Abyss, find and enter the altar rift, then leave the altar via the portal. No tiaras or talismans are necessary when entering the portals to go to the various altars via the Abyss.

get_inside.text: The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.
Options to reach the asylum include:
Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor surface, then run south-west to the ancient door.

place.title: Senntisten Asylum
place.summary: Between the abyssal savages and abyssal lords is an asylum gate. The gate requires a gate key to unlock that can be obtained as a drop from abyssal lords. Once the gate is unlocked, players can bring a rope to hang from the broken railing to unlock a permanent shortcut to the lords. It is not required to open the door to access the lords as players can simply run around the asylum to reach the area, although it is longer, and players must run through aggressive abyssal beasts.

get_inside.text: The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.
Options to reach the asylum include:
Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor surface, then run south-west to the ancient door.

get_inside.text: To enter the Abyss, the player needs to complete the Enter the Abyss miniquest. Once players have completed the miniquest, they can use the 'Teleport' option on the Mage of Zamorak north of Edgeville in level 4 to 6 Wilderness to enter the Abyss.
Strategy

For convenience, players can make the Mage of Zamorak teleport them straight away with a left-click by going through his 'Configure' option; this only has to be done once. Completing the Wilderness achievements increases the rate of gathering magical thread by 5% (easy), 10% (medium), 15% (hard), or 33% (elite).
Other notes

Inside the Abyss, the player is no longer in the Wilderness and cannot be attacked by other players. However, if a player attacks immediately before a player enters the Abyss, the attack can hit after the player has been teleported inside due to lag. If the player is teleblocked by another player before entering, using the 'Teleport' option on the Zamorak Mage will not work.

Altars are located throughout the world, often near points of interest. If no other teleports are available, the abyss is useful as an alternate method of teleportation. Some useful locations include:
Air altar - Cooks' Guild, west of Varrock
Astral altar - Lunar Isle, switching spellbooks on the altar
Blood altar - Master clue skill riddle, mutated bloodvelds for slayer,
Body altar - Barbarian Village
Cosmic altar - Elite clue Zanaris scan spots, mutated zygomites for slayer
Death altar - Master clue skill riddle, end of the Temple of Light from the quest Mourning's End Part II, re-entering the Underground Pass to get Iban's staff
Earth altar - East of Varrock elite clue spots
Fire altar - Mage Training Arena, Het's Oasis, Al Kharid
Law altar - Entrana
Mind altar - Goblin Village, Black Knight's Fortress elite clue spot
Nature altar - Gleaming wisps, Karamja, Shilo Village, hard and elite clue spots
Soul altar - Far west of Menaphos Imperial district for City Quests and elite clue scan spots, fairy ring
Time altar - Access to venomous, feral, and brutish dinosaurs for slayer
Water altar - Lumbridge Swamp, Zanaris

To use a teleport, enter the Abyss, find and enter the altar rift, then leave the altar via the portal. No tiaras or talismans are necessary when entering the portals to go to the various altars via the Abyss.

Teleport using the Dungeoneering cape or a charged hoardstalker ring to the Brimhaven metal dragon dungeon.

Teleport to the Catherby lodestone, and charter a ship (480 coins) to Brimhaven, then run south
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Karamja gloves 3 to Shilo Village and then the Shilo Village cart system to Brimhaven. Using a cart costs 10 coins.

get_inside.text: Asgarnia and Kandarin border
To traverse the exterior of the mountain:

Travel via the Gnome glider network to the Sindarpos location, which takes you to the east of the cave that leads to Catherby as well as a Hidey-hole location for one of the Treasure trail (hard) emote clues. Completion of The Grand Tree quest is required to use the gliders. To reach the cave entrance that leads back to Taverley, run north.

Home Teleport to the Taverley lodestone then run south and then north around the bank. Follow the path past the Land of Snow portal (used in the Violet is Blue quest) to your west until your reach a cave entrance. Entering the cave at the end of the path will take you to the area with wolves, Gnome glider, and cave entrance to Catherby.

Home teleport to the Catherby lodestone then run east past the fishing area on the beach then north. Follow that path to the cave entrance that will take you to the area with wolves, Gnome glider, and cave entrance to Taverley.
To traverse the interior of the mountain (requires completion of Fishing Contest quest):

To go from Taverley to Catherby: Enter the cave entrance directly to the north of the Taverley Player-owned house portal. Following the underground passage will lead to a cave exit just east of the Catherby farming patch.
To go from Catherby to Taverley: Enter the cave entrance to the east of the Catherby farming patch. Follow the underground path which exits just north of the Taverley Player-owned house portal.

This tunnel features a cart station that leads to Keldagrim. There is also various affordable teleportation jewellery that can land players beyond the mountain, including games necklace and ring of duelling, and a boat from Port Sarim to Catherby; Catherby has a lodestone so the mountain only needs to be 'crossed' once.

get_inside.text: Misthalin
Varrock east entrance
Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

Varrock south entrance.png | Varrock south entrance
Varrock north entrance.png | Varrock north gate

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.

It is the largest city for non-members and one of largest cities overall.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.
• Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
• A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

Varrock east entrance.png | Varrock east entrance
Varrock south entrance.png | Varrock south entrance
Varrock north entrance.png | Varrock north gate

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.

place.title: Dominion Tower
place.summary: The Dominion Tower houses a minigame which gives players the opportunity to re-fight various bosses from 60 quests plus a non-quest Dominion Tower boss - Sunfreet. It is located in the northern Kharidian Desert, near the source of the River Elid. The minigame gives rewards including combat experience, new consumable items, and dominion glove sets. In general players use the tower for prestige or to gain its non-tradeable rewards rather than to make money. The history of the Tower is revealed in the Dominion journal, which is acquired as one beats bosses. The tower was constructed by an individual known as The Founder, while a stone face which is said to come from ancient times manages the tower.

get_inside.text: Ancient Cavern
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.

place.title: Kuradal's Dungeon

The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

The Mahjarrat Ritual Site is an icy region located between the Trollweiss Mountains and Wilderness. The Mahjarrat travel to the area every 500 years in order to perform the Ritual of Rejuvenation, a ceremony in which one Mahjarrat is sacrificed to rejuvenate the others. A number of Mahjarrat have or had territory in and around the area, including Zemouregal, Lucien and General Khazard.

Inside the labyrinth, the gods and other divine beings have had their divinity removed, putting them on an equal playing field with the World Guardian. The labyrinth is split into two parts, in which the player has to travel from the most south-west room to the most north-east. The first to the end of the first labyrinth gets to remove the entourage of one of the participants; the first two to reach the end of the second labyrinth (one of which is always the World Guardian, the other being Armadyl, Saradomin, or Zamorak) engage in a footrace for the Stone of Jas.

Canifis is a village that lies to the east of Paterdomus, across the River Salve, in Morytania. It is the village of the werewolves and is accessible only to members.
place.teleport:
• Canifis lodestone
• Fairy ring CKS
• Kharyrll Teleport
• Portal Chamber

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
• Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
• The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
• Focussing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
• Fairy Ring code CKS.
• After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
• After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
• Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

place.title: Miscellania Castle
place.summary: King Vargas initially appears as a yeti, a beast-like creature, that he was transformed into many years ago after an encounter with a gnoeals. Due to this, he seeks a regent to take over the Throne of Miscellania, as he is unfit to rule in his current state. The new regent must then deal with Etceteria, who they are at war with, despite neither nation having a military, broker a peace treaty with Queen Sigrid, and sort out the Royal Trouble.

ml.name: Menaphos
ml.text: location: Menaphos

get_inside.text: The Menaphos lodestone teleports players directly to the centre of the city.
If the Menaphos lodestone hasn't been unlocked yet, players can teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone, then run south.
If Pharaoh's Folly is completed, Leela's favour may teleport players to various Menaphos destinations.
The magic carpet system can be used to travel to the gates of Menaphos.
pic: Quick travel interface prior to 3 July 2017

get_inside.text: The camulet can teleport players to Enakhra's Temple, which is underground just north of Menaphos.
Players can also travel to Sophanem first. Any forms of transportation that originate within Sophanem require completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
A bridge connects Sophanem and Menaphos, but it is inaccessible from the Sophanem side if the player hasn't completed the quest 'Phite Club.
Exit Sophanem from the north gate, run north and cross the River Elid, run south, and enter Menaphos through its north gate.
Alternatively, after exiting Sophanem, take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach, then take another carpet trip to Menaphos.
Imperial district
The nature's sentinel outfit can teleport players to the acadia trees in the Imperial district.
The sceptre of the gods can teleport the player directly to the Golden Palace (Jalkabir) in the Imperial district.
A fairy ring (CKQ) is located near the fountain behind the Golden Palace.
Port district
The player can speak to Quartermaster Gully on any of the islands in The Arc to return to Menaphos, but only if their starting point was Menaphos.

The player can use the Captain's Log to teleport to the Player-owned port and then exit the portal to get to the port district, but only if they had visited the Player-owned port via Port district the last time.
A player-owned house portal is in the Port district, north-east of Kags.
A charter ship to the north-western dock in the Port district for 1,500 coins.
Slayer Codex teleport and the boat to Menaphos can be used via Portmaster Kags.
Between districts
Travel between the four districts of Menaphos can be simplified by using a right-click interface on the entrance of the Shifting Tombs found in each district.

Prior to an update on 3 July 2017, a right click would give the option of "Quick travel RSFont | shadow=no | Shifting tombs | color=aqua ". Five options were available including entering the Shifting Tombs and quick travel to the entrance of each district's Shifting Tombs entrance.

ml.name: Temple of Aminishi
ml.text: Anagami are enemies encountered in the Temple of Aminishi. They can be found in a group on the second section of the dungeon, along with Arhats. Unlike the Anagamis outside the temple, these Anagamis do not use the electric attack.

pic: For dungeon map, see article — Aminishi

start_overview: For dungeon map, see article — Aminishi

get_inside.text: Aminishi
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

place.title: Temple of Aminishi
place.summary: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens. The Temple of Aminishi is located on the island of Aminishi and requires completion of Impressing the Locals to access. The grouping system is required in order to form a team of 2-3 players.

pic: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor — Kharidian Desert
start_here.entrance_name: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor

start_overview: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor — Kharidian Desert

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
The entrance area of The Heart
pic: The entrance area of The Heart

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.
Heart of Gielinor

place.title: Heart of Gielinor
place.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).

Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

get_inside.text: Asgarnia
The entrance to the courtyard.
Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.
Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

get_inside.text: Baxtorian Lake

The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)
Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.
Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.

The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.

place.title: Tolna's rift
place.summary: This dungeon is designed to be efficient for players training their combat skills. The monsters here have fairly high life points and relatively low defence. However, as the area is designed purely with combat training in mind, almost none of the monsters drop any items. This does, however, mean that players can stock their entire inventory with food without having to worry about having to drop some should they get an item.

ml.name: Morytania
ml.text: Angry vampyres are a possible result of using a dose of Guthix balance on a vampyre juvenile or vampyre juvinate. They become enraged, and attack you, but unlike normally, they can be harmed with any weapon, not just silver. They physically appear to be a larger version of the feral vampyres that inhabit Morytania, and they do in fact count for Vampyres Slayer assignment.

get_inside.text: Canifis

Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus via the mausoleum outside and just north of the Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
Focusing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
Fairy ring code CKS.

After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

place.title: Morytania
place.summary: In order to access Morytania for the first time, players must either complete the Priest in Peril quest or kill a ghoul in the mausoleum below Paterdomus, accessed from the stairs in the graveyard, north of the temple, then go through the holy barrier keeping Morytania's dark forces outside of Misthalin. This should not be hard; even skillers can do this with rings of recoil, and an inventory of food. Players should only need to attack the ghoul once, then equip the ring of recoil and the ghoul will do the rest.

ml.name: Warriors' Guild
ml.text: Animated Adamant Armour is found in the Warriors' Guild. They can be killed to earn Warrior guild tokens, which can be used to enter the Cyclops Room on the upper floor. Players can create this monster by putting an adamant full helmet, adamant platebody and adamant platelegs on the magical animator on the floor 1. get_inside.text: Burthorpe
The Warriors' Guild is located in Burthorpe and can be accessed in a number of ways:
Burthorpe lodestone, which will teleport players directly east of the guild.
Combat bracelet, which will teleport players to a location directly outside the guild.
Games necklace, which will teleport players to Troll Invasion, just north of the guild.

place.title: Warriors' Guild

ml.text: Animated Runite Armour is found at the Warriors' Guild and is the most powerful Animated Armour in the Animated Armour activity. In order to summon it, players must put a rune full helm, a rune platebody and rune platelegs on the Magical Animator. This is one of the quickest ways to get tokens. Low-levelled players are advised to bring food and wear stab-resistant armour. It is the highest level animated armour. The player may not get all of their rune armour parts back when it is defeated; however, the better defensive bonuses the armour provides, the lower the chances of losing 1 or more parts. It is weak to crush attacks, although any melee weapon will suffice at higher levels. The armour is immune to ranged, magic, and necromancy attacks.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Warriors' Guild is located in Burthorpe and can be accessed in a number of ways:
• Burthorpe lodestone, which will teleport players directly east of the guild.
• Combat bracelet, which will teleport players to a location directly outside the guild.
• Games necklace, which will teleport players to Troll Invasion, just north of the guild.

There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.

get_inside.text: South-west Morytania

get_inside.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.
Map:Abandoned Mine surface

The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.
Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.
To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.
To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).
To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):
#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.
To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):
# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.
To get to the crystal mine (with the crystal-mine key):
# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).

pic: Location of the tower — West of Uzer

start_overview: Location of the tower — West of Uzer

get_inside.text: West of Uzer

Use a Dominion medallion or Super dominion medallion to teleport there. This requires a minimum of being able to compete in the Dominion Tower (at least 20 of the 38 quests completed); if able to compete in the Dominion Tower, one can obtain the medallion on a previous trip to the tower. Both versions of the medallion allows a maximum of three teleports per day to the tower.

If the player's player-owned house is located in the Menaphos Port district or if by using a Menaphos tablet (requires the Love Story quest), players can teleport to Port district's dock, use right-click "Travel" option on Portmaster Kags and choose Dominion Tower, this is one of the quickest ways to get to Dominion Tower. Using the teleport option on a Slayer codex with at least 50 souls added also gets you within a few steps of the Portmaster.

Go through the Shantay Pass, run East-South-East to the River Elid, cross the bridge and go slightly North to reach the tower. The quickest transport to the Pass is by using a broomstick, or a charged Amulet of glory.

Use the Eagle transport system (requires completing the Eagles' Peak quest) or Fairy ring DLQ (requires partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest) to travel to the Uzer Hunter area and run north-west.

Use a Pollnivneach teleport scroll, Pollnivneach tablet (requires completing the Love Story quest) or ring of slaying (requires the ability to purchase or make the ring) to teleport to Pollnivneach, then run north along the River Elid until the bridge, cross that bridge and go north.
Use a Desert amulet 2, 3 or 4's Nardah teleport ability, then run north along the Elid.

place.title: Dominion Tower
place.summary: The Dominion Tower houses a minigame which gives players the opportunity to re-fight various bosses from 60 quests plus a non-quest Dominion Tower boss - Sunfreet. It is located in the northern Kharidian Desert, near the source of the River Elid. The minigame gives rewards including combat experience, new consumable items, and dominion glove sets. In general players use the tower for prestige or to gain its non-tradeable rewards rather than to make money. The history of the Tower is revealed in the Dominion journal, which is acquired as one beats bosses. The tower was constructed by an individual known as The Founder, while a stone face which is said to come from ancient times manages the tower.

place.title: Burthorpe
place.summary: The Troll Country is immediately north of Burthorpe, and due to that, the city has come under constant attacks, raids, and invasions by the trolls, having led to the Burthorpe - Troll Country War. Death Plateau in particular seems a threat, as many heavily armed trolls have a permanent camp there. The Imperial Guard, with help of adventurers, has been taking measures to reduce this threat. Trolls are often seen invading the town, slaughtering families and soldiers alike. If the trolls were to overrun Burthorpe, Falador will use it as a reason to disband the Imperial Guard and the town would come under control of the White Knights. Commander Denulth considers the White Knights to be taking advantage of King Vallance, who he describes as "old and weak".

get_inside.text: Kandarin
East Ardougne
The Ardougne lodestone is located just north of the city, directly southwest of Manor Farm.
The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the player to the centre of Ardougne market, requiring completion of the Plague City quest.
The Ardougne cloak 1 can be used to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, just south of the city.
Once per day, the Ardougne cloak 2/3 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm, just north of the city.
The Ardougne cloak 4 provides unlimited teleports to Manor Farm.
A spirit tree is located on the Battlefield south of West Ardougne, requiring completion of the Tree Gnome Village quest.

A lever in the Deserted Keep in level 51 Wilderness teleports the player to the Ardougne lever, near the gates to West Ardougne, and vice versa. The lever can be accessed by teleporting to the Keep from Edgeville, although doing so will momentarily put the player in deep wilderness.

There is a ship that will take the player to Ardougne from Brimhaven for the low price of 30 coins. The ship takes you to the south eastern docks near Captain Barnaby. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will allow you to travel to and from Brimhaven for free.
West Ardougne
There are only a few ways to enter West Ardougne, with some of them only available during specific quests.
Through the main door in the West Ardougne eastern wall after the Biohazard quest.
Use the Ardougne lodestone and run south and west across the river.
Use a spirit tree to teleport to the Khazard battlefield and run north and enter West Ardougne through the wall
Use the Ardougne Teleport to arrive in the East Ardougne centre and run west across the river and around the castle.
Use Kandarin monastery Teleport (requires unlocking Ardougne cloak 1) to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north-west across the river.
Breaking a 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport to arrive just south-east of the main doors of the Civic Office of West Ardougne. Requires the completion of Plague City, Evil Dave's Big Day Out and 51 Magic.
Through the pipeline in the sewers under Edmond's house after the partial completion of the Plague City quest. This way becomes inaccessible after the Biohazard quest is started.

Talking to Omart near the southern end of the eastern wall during the Biohazard quest. After the quest the passage over the wall can be used only from West to East Ardougne by talking to Kilron. The wall cannot be passed this way anymore after Plague's End.
Through the Underground Pass from Tirannwn. Requires starting Regicide.

Using a crystal teleport seed or its attuned version to teleport to the Temple of Light. Run east of through the Mourner tunnels and climb the ladder to Mourner Headquarters. Requires the completion of Within the Light.

start_overview: For dungeon map, see article — Aminishi

get_inside.text: Aminishi
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

place.title: Misthalin
place.summary:
Most of the population outside the capital consists of farmers and other such people who labour in the wealth of the breadbasket of Misthalin, which is concentrated in the south. This effectively splits the kingdom's community in two.
Cquote2 | Misthalin is a nation split quite evenly in two. The population outside Varrock is predominantly agricultural, and provides a great deal of food for the capital and for sale to other, poorer nations. The people of the capital, though, are largely tradesmen and artisans, who work with raw materials to produce something more immediately useful. This split in society may seem to work effectively, but the problem can be seen most clearly in the southern parts of Varrock. This is where the rural citizens who have come to the capital frequently end up, unskilled and naive, living off scraps and dressing in the rags of clothes discarded by the wealthy. | Game Guide

ml.text: The Armadylean shaman was a follower of Armadyl encountered during Wilderness Warbands. They primarily attacked their targets with magic, using the spell Fire Surge and various abilities. They wielded staves but their standard attacks were as fast as they would have been with a wand. ml.name: Chaos Temple Dungeon

get_inside.text: Wilderness

Talk to Hartwin in the north-west tower of Varrock Palace and he will teleport players right next to the trapdoor leading into the dungeon. Although it is nominally located at the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness, there is no way to access the dungeon from the true Wilderness, nor any way to return to the Wilderness from the safe area. If the player has opted into PvP, standard restrictions apply (coins cannot be put in the money pouch, disassembly is disabled, etc.), but player killing will not be possible, as the instance is not shared but unique for each player. If players walk to the edge of the safe area, they will be given the option of returning to Varrock Palace.
The entrance to the dungeon is behind (south of) the Chaos altar within the temple. Players must have completed at least part of the Defender of Varrock quest to enter the dungeon.

ml.name: Uncharted Isles
ml.text: Armoured zombies are monsters that can be found randomly on Uncharted Isles, alongside their non-armoured counterparts. They may be killed for combat experience and chimes. While not aggressive, they are accurate and can hit hard if players are unprepared for combat. The zombies are usually found in large groups making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks or abilities against them.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

ml.name: Temple Trekking
ml.text: Asyn shadow are monsters that can be encountered in Temple Trekking while travelling along the medium route, which attempt to break into the houses of the three unafflicted people in Mort'ton.

get_inside.text: Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.
Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.
There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
Games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale).
Kharyrll Teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure and 66 Magic).

Fairy ring code CKS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather and at least a dramen staff if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and Lunar Diplomacy are not completed).
Teleport to Canifis via the Canifis lodestone and enter the long cave through the trapdoor behind the pub for exit near the rowboat to Mort'ton.
Teleport to the Slayer Tower just north of Canifis using a slayer ring.

place.title: Temple Trekking
place.summary: Temple Trekking is a minigame in which players must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to Paterdomus, which requires completion of the In Aid of the Myreque quest. On the way, the player must pass through Morytania's many dangers and obstacles, protecting the accompanying traveller until they reach the temple. The player must find a way across bogs and rivers and fight dangerous packs of monsters lurking in Morytania, some unique to this minigame.

ml.name: Heart of Gielinor

pic: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor — Kharidian Desert
start_here.entrance_name: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor

start_overview: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor — Kharidian Desert

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
The entrance area of The Heart
pic: The entrance area of The Heart

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.
Heart of Gielinor

place.title: Heart of Gielinor
place.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).

• Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.
• The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
• Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
• Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
• Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
• Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
• Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
• Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
• Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
• Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
• Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros

Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.

Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.
